items.quote: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: the LORD is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.
items.claim: The text says Pharaoh sent for Moses and Aaron and told them he had sinned this time. He called the LORD righteous and said that he and his people were wicked.
items.mechanism: verbal confession acknowledging the LORD's righteousness and the wickedness of Pharaoh and his people
